source_pin.qualification: Parent verified wrapper and hosted pin; this reader semantically reviewed selected public source chains below. Hosted source is not proven byte-identical to the installed build. Public packages do not establish user DLC entitlement or active runtime data.

method.semantic_review: Targeted complete functions and cross-file caller/consumer chains, not whole-file or whole-game coverage.
method.validation: Source range and JSON-pointer readback, source hashes, artifact JSON parse. No game execution, tests, build, save, account, install or entitlement changes.
method.numbers: Recipe base intervals/costs and explicitly zero-modifier arithmetic are not promises of actual starting or late-game rates; mastery, equipment, modes, relics and package modifications change them.

chains.name: Gathered wood and smelted ore become spent ranged ammunition
chains.prerequisite: Unlocked gathering/Smithing/Fletching and their level-1 recipes, an admissible tree/rock, 15 owned feathers, bank space, and an owned compatible ranged weapon/quiver. Feathers are a separate bottleneck, not generated by woodcutting.
chains.decision: Choose the log type for Arrow Shafts, then smelt bronze, smith arrowtips, attach feathers, and tip the arrows; equip the actual arrow stack.
chains.base_cost_time: 1 Normal Log ->15 shafts at Fletching base2s; 15 shafts+15 feathers ->15 headless arrows at2s; 1 Copper Ore+1 Tin Ore ->1 Bronze Bar at Smithing2s; 1 bar ->15 tips at2s; 15 tips+15 headless arrows ->15 Bronze Arrows at2s. Normal tree base3s, Copper/Tin each Mining3s: a nominal19s action-time pipeline before modifiers, rock downtime, acquisition/selection/equipment or combat. Declared feather shop cost8GP each gives120GP for15; purchasing execution is outside this trace.
chains.mutation: Gathering gives real bank items; crafting checks each entire current cost bundle, rolls preservation, spends the bundle before rewards, and separately adds XP/mastery. Arrow alternative material changes output quantity, not a generic skill bonus.
chains.consumer: player.equipItem conserves bank/equipment stock; ranged attack requires matching ammoType. consumeAmmo removes one quiver item on the first attack proc unless preserved; equipment removes depleted stacks and recomputes stats.
chains.failure_aftermath: Missing any next crafting input stops the skill; depleted mining nodes wait for respawn. Incompatible or empty ammo prevents the next ranged attack and reports wrong/no ammo. Full-bank reward loss can occur after craft inputs and time were spent (shared parent OFF02); owned feathers and combat XP do not replace missing arrows.

sources.function_chain: equipItem -> remove bank stock -> equip stack

chains.name: Fishing and cooking create healing stock, with a different passive route
chains.prerequisite: Fishing1, Cooking1, selected Raw Shrimp in Shallow Shores, actual raw fish and supported food slots. Tutorial outcomes and ordinary outcomes differ.
chains.decision: Select area/fish, actively cook Shrimp, then equip and eat the actual cooked item. Alternatively passive-cook a different category only while actively cooking another category.
chains.base_cost_time: Raw Shrimp action samples4-8s; Shallow Shores declares75% fish/25% junk/0% special before modifiers (tutorial forces fish). Active Shrimp consumes1 raw shrimp at recipe base2s; Cooking base success70% plus modifiers, including recipe mastery. A successful base batch yields1 cooked/perfect item, each a distinct real item. Passive interval is5x modified cooking interval, nominal10s for Shrimp; costs remain real.
chains.mutation: Crafting consumes/preserves inputs before active success roll. Successful active cooking awards food, XP/common rewards/mastery or auto-equips if earned/enabled. Failure yields no ordinary food/XP; special Pig+Mole/Abyssal failure modifiers can add byproducts. Passive cooking directly spends costs and adds recipe.baseQuantity of normal product to category stockpile; it does not run the active success/perfect/doubling/preservation/XP/mastery/common-reward path.
chains.consumer: Stockpile collection moves retained goods into bank only on successful addition. equipFood removes stock from bank. eatFood heals using item.healsFor * mode multiplier plus current food-healing modifiers, then consumes actual slot quantity unless preserved; Shrimp declares healsFor3.
chains.failure_aftermath: Burning loses the paid raw fish unless the crafting preservation roll saved it. Missing ingredients stop cooking. Stopping active cooking stops all passive timers; existing stockpiles remain. Full bank prevents collecting a stockpile and leaves it retained. Empty food without enabled/earned swapping cannot heal; at full HP eating returns without spending. No passive multiplier alone supplies cooked goods.

sources.function_chain: active success/failure -> common rewards; passive stockpile/costs; onStop

chains.name: Marks require obtained tablets; synergy spends both equipped familiars
chains.prerequisite: Ent: Summoning1 and Woodcutting; Octopus: Summoning15 and Fishing. Applicable unlocked skill/realm action rolls the first mark. Further rolls require itemFindCount(tablet)>=1 after mark level>0; finding a mark is not a paid tablet stack. Mark quick-create appears after discovery.
chains.decision: Choose one log/fish alternative, craft real tablets, equip both actual stacks, continue the relevant skills to obtain enough marks, and use the unlocked pair.
chains.base_cost_time: Each base Ent/Octopus batch yields25 tablets after Summoning base5s and costs6 green shards plus chosen material. Non-shard quantity is ceil(1000/max(20,item sale value)) before reductions, minimum1. Thus Normal Logs/Raw Shrimp (sale1) cost50 each under zero modifiers. Green shard declared shop price200GP: six purchased shards1200GP per batch. The1000 target is not always1000GP of sacrificed materials because of the minimum20 valuation. No purchase runtime is claimed.
chains.mutation: Crafting adds tablet bank stack and XP/mastery; successful bank addition increments TimesFound. Marks increment marksUnlocked; thresholds1,6,16,31,46,61. Ent+Octopus tier1 pair ordinarily needs each mark level>1, so at least6 discoveries each. Modifiers/relic can bypass that unlock condition.
chains.consumer: Ent own item adds10% extra primary product chance to Woodcutting; Octopus adds3% to Fishing. Pair adds6 to Woodcutting Bird Nest chance and6 to Melvor Fishing special chance. player.computeSummoningSynergy installs only unlocked equipped pair. Own consumesOn listener spends relevant familiar; synergy listener spends both on matched Woodcutting/Fishing event. Away from depletion and with zero preservation, a Woodcutting event therefore requests2 Ent charges+1 Octopus, Fishing requests2 Octopus+1 Ent. Charge use separately awards Summoning XP before the preservation roll except Eternal damage type.
chains.failure_aftermath: Missing selected materials stops crafting; there is no automatic fallback to another material. Full bank on first tablet prevents TimesFound and can keep further mark rolls blocked even after paid crafting. Depleted equipped stacks are unequipped and stats/listeners recomputed, removing current bonuses/synergy; mark discovery persists. Exact final-charge event listener order and late preservation interactions are runtime-unverified.

chains.name: Herb seed risk becomes a charged production potion
chains.prerequisite: Owned2 Garum Seeds, Farming5 and empty eligible Herb plot; Herblore1 and2 separate Potato Seeds for Bird Nest Potion. Seeds and plot access are prerequisites rather than free rewards.
chains.decision: Plant Garum, optionally improve compost/safety, wait, harvest, choose to sacrifice herb plus potato seeds to a potion, activate it for Woodcutting and choose auto-reuse only if desired.
chains.base_cost_time: Garum declares2 seeds and5400000ms (90min) growth. Plant consumes seed stock immediately. Base growth chance50+compostLevel/2 unless current cropsCannotDie. FarmingRecipe baseQuantity5, Herb harvestMultiplier2: nominal10 herbs before modifiers after successful growth/harvest. Bird Nest Potion consumes1 Garum Herb+2 Potato Seeds and Herblore base2s to make1 potion of current recipe mastery tier.
chains.mutation: plantPlot stores Growing recipe/time; passive growth callback resolves Grown/Dead. Successful harvest first adds goods to bank, then gives XP/mastery/possible returned seeds and resets plot. Herb category also grants XP on planting; failure does not mean every prior XP disappears. Herblore mastery tiers1/20/50/90 select one of four actual potion IDs; prior low-tier stock is not retroactively rewritten. Separate bank upgrade recipes trade3 lower-tier potions for1 next-tier.
chains.consumer: Bird Nest Potion I declares50 charges and+5 Bird Nest chance on Woodcutting. usePotion consumes1 real bank potion, stores active charges and registers consumesOn; provider stats enter shared player modifiers. Each matched Woodcutting action consumes a charge unless preserved, regardless whether a nest appears. Woodcutting.getRandomProductInfo consumes the current scoped chance.
chains.failure_aftermath: Dead crops retain spent seeds/time and must be cleared; successful harvest blocked by full bank leaves plot grown. Potion activation requires stock. At zero charges, only enabled auto-reuse with owned same potion reloads; otherwise provider/listener removed. Recipe mastery and planted/harvested history persist, but absent herbs/seeds cannot be replaced by passive potion or mastery bonuses.

chains.name: Pool mastery is spendable specialization with reversible safety loss
chains.prerequisite: A skill-with-mastery action and enough realm-specific mastery pool XP for requested recipe levels. Pool cap depends on the number of mastery actions in that realm, not merely current skill level.
chains.decision: Retain pool checkpoint passives or exchange exact pool XP for particular action mastery; optional confirmation warns when active checkpoints will be lost.
chains.cost_time: Successful common-reward actions accumulate recipe XP and pool XP. Pool reward is1/4 recipe mastery XP below skill99 and1/2 at99+. getBaseMasteryPoolCap is500000 per true mastery action in realm. Spending adds the exact action XP then subtracts same pool XP. This costs previously earned time/opportunities rather than inventory stock.
chains.mutation: Recipe mastery persists and its scoped modifiers can increase even while pool falls. Bonus count/provided stats are recomputed when checkpoint changes; level/pool are separate stores. Farm25% pool is cropsCannotDie; Cooking95% is+10 Normal-damage food healing; Firemaking95% gives+5 realm-scoped masteryXP across skills.
chains.consumer: Actual getPlotGrowthChance reads the current cropsCannotDie modifier at growth completion; eatFood reads current healing modifiers when consuming food; other skills getMasteryXPModifier reads current shared providers. Therefore pool spending can change already planted crops or already cooked food usefulness without removing the physical items or learned recipe XP.
chains.failure_aftermath: Insufficient pool does nothing. Spending below Farm25% restores50+compost/2 growth chance if no other safety source; previously paid seeds can subsequently die. Dropping Cooking95% loses the healing bonus on future eating. These are source-derived conditional effects, not observed runtime outcomes. Avoid treating retained recipe mastery as a permanently retained checkpoint.

chains.name: Stardust purchase becomes retained interskill mastery bonus
chains.prerequisite: Unlocked Astrology and Deedree, current action mastery40 for the second standard star, and owned Stardust.
chains.decision: Spend active study time to gather stardust and earn mastery, then upgrade Deedree standard mastery star instead of spending dust elsewhere.
chains.base_cost_time: Astrology base3s actions; base random Stardust chance5% and Golden Stardust2% independently before modifiers. Deedree second standard star costs10,20,40,80,160,320,640,1280 ordinary Stardust over8 purchases. Each increments+1 masteryXP for Woodcutting and Farming. Studying is active time allocation; the purchased effect is not a carried material output.
chains.mutation: checkAndConsumeAstroModCosts spends actual dust before incrementing timesBought; unlocked/isMaxed guards apply. addAstroModProvidedStats rebuilds retained modifiers from purchases, with no per-use charge decrement.
chains.consumer: Game registers skill.providedStats; player.addProviderModifiers imports them; game.modifiers aliases that player table. Woodcutting/Farming mastery calculations query scoped masteryXP even while Astrology is not actively studying.
chains.failure_aftermath: Locked, maxed or missing dust prevents upgrade; bank-full dust loss during study can delay the next purchase. Purchased bonuses remain without replenishing dust; they improve progression/throughput and do not mint logs, herbs or seed stock. Ancient Relics mode master relic doubles purchased constellation stats only for a complete constellation; this is not ordinary universal2x.

chains.name: Built obstacle passives depend on contiguous course and impose tradeoffs
chains.prerequisite: Unlocked course slot, skill requirements and real construction money/items. Slot/category and sequential course support differ from merely owning an obstacle definition.
chains.decision: Build Cargo Net or select a later obstacle for useful off-skill bonuses; choose whether later gathering doubling is worth artisan preservation penalty, and pay again to replace the slot.
chains.base_cost_time: Cargo Net declares10000GP construction,4s running,8XP and6GP action rewards; its built passive is+3GP gain and+2 Fishing masteryXP. Rock Climb requires level30 Woodcutting/Fishing/Mining/Thieving,500 Teak Logs+500 Coal+500 Onion Seeds+500000GP; declares+5 doubling to those four skills with global-10 preservation chance.
chains.mutation: Building consumes modified costs, stores obstacle per slot and increments historical build count; repeated builds reduce item cost4% each up to10 builds, with95% or earned100% reduction cap. Running cycles contiguous built obstacles; it is separate from passive provision. Replacing/destroying updates built map and recomputes stats without material refund in reviewed destroy function.
chains.consumer: forEachActiveObstacle stops at first gap/dummy in each course, so later constructed obstacles past a gap lose passive provision too. Current preservation chance is consumed by CraftingSkill.action; gathering doubling is consumed by actual yield methods. Negative modifiers are real costs of loadout, not descriptive flavor.
chains.failure_aftermath: Unavailable stock/slot/skill blocks build; removing an early obstacle can disable later passives and pillar support. Mastery/relic may halve/eliminate negatives under explicit modifiers/mode; a base reward is not always positive overall. Blueprint/UI runtime and full course progression were not exercised.

additional_findings.fact: Crafting pays current bundled item/currency costs before output, with80% base preservation cap plus explicit cap modifiers; ordinary item-cost reduction caps80%, ceil and minimum1. Missing next inputs rechecks after every cycle. This preserves a real throughput/input bottleneck even at high mastery. Specific Smithing removeCoalCosts can override Coal cost to0.

Shared action timer clamps modified skill intervals to at least250ms. Mastery interval is skill-specific: Woodcutting/Mining use actual interval; Fletching1300ms and Smithing/Herblore1700ms are fixed reference values; Cooking uses85% base recipe interval. Faster production does not automatically mean equal per-action mastery policy across skills.

Logs have competing material uses: shafts, Familiar tablets, Firemaking burn, bonfire. Normal Firemaking spends1 log per2s burn before preservation; post-tutorial primary products include Coal with declared40% chance. Bonfire spends10 logs for20s Normal bonfire+5 Firemaking XP; expiry attempts re-light while skill active and payment can fail. Free bonfires exception does not waive Abyssal bonfire costs.

additional_findings.fact: Runecrafting consumes actual Essence rather than granting spells. Base Air and Mind Rune each cost1 Rune Essence at base2s; Wind Strike requires2 Air+1 Mind per ordinary spell cost. Mining Essence gives2 at base3s. player.attack checks current bank rune bundle, consumes unless preserved, and suppresses damage on insufficient runes; aurora use can separately consume another bundle in the same attack.
additional_findings.limit: This traces a named production-to-consumption connection, not a full spellbook/Alt Magic audit. Staff reduction/combo substitutions alter live getRuneCosts and were not reviewed here.

additional_findings.fact: Multiple simultaneous Woodcutting trees are explicitly capped and must share realm; action interval is slowest selected tree, faster trees multiply output by slowest/current ratio. Shaft-generating modifiers use real Fletching alternative-cost match against tree.product. This is a defined production shortcut, not automatic generic interskill conversion.

larger_original_implications.idea: Treat professions as competing uses of the same owned goods: expedition supplies, charged tools, sale, learning inputs and infrastructure. A retained technique may improve one conversion while a current loaded tool still has to be paid and replenished. Existing Eda/workshop routes already demonstrate this distinction; extend exact consumers before adding a global mastery bar.

Preparation specialization can trade throughput against reliability or later function. Pool-spending safety loss and Agility positive/negative loadouts suggest contextual choices, but no copied realm-wide numerical penalty or universal pool/reset is selected. YAIRPG can keep this within one local actor/body/bench campaign.

Late recipes can keep earlier ordinary places useful through material demand rather than mandatory chores. TotH base rune sinks and expansion append-only alternatives support deliberate return trips and substitutes, without granting an imported world/power or replacing current clock/inventory.

Separate practice reward, physical output and ongoing support. A failed prepared job can retain learned history while creating no goods; supplied consumable bonuses can expire while acquired knowledge persists. Any adaptation needs disclosed reservation, cancellation and downstream native effect, not an extra idle ticker.

small_original_adaptation_proposals.name: Choose a finite kit-reserve recipe from recipes you can actually use
small_original_adaptation_proposals.problem: The live ordinary clamping-frame recipe and resin route produce the same native kits with different paid inputs/time, but only the resin route has a finite stock-aware reserve consumer.
small_original_adaptation_proposals.player_choice: At Eda's known retained bench, deliberately choose either the existing resin route or the earned ordinary-frame route for the next at-most3 accepted batches. Show the quoted sap/resin/staves/stamina/time and required frame/charge provenance. Never automatically change route when one input runs out.
small_original_adaptation_proposals.reuse: Existing native kit item/owned inventory, actor/body/bench right, accepted job, common clock, lower2/upper4 hysteresis, exact batch output and sole durable publisher. Reuse audit_fixture.bind_kits and reference_gameplay.resin_kits rather than creating alternate balances or goods.

Add one explicit frame-route plan/facts projection and narrowly admitted exact-definition branch. No general purpose crafting planner is required.

Frame route must require explicit new optional accepted plan/receipt and existing audit fixture enrollment; absent state inert. Named route stored as exact definition/revision, not inferred from old completed counts. If additional state field/schema is required, migration/compatibility decision and later save/reload gate belong to integrator.

A chosen frame batch spends1 sap+2 sound staves+2 stamina, reserves6 played minutes and creates2 native kits; the selected resin route retains3min terms. Spend kits through an existing field consumer; hold/resume at4/2, pause on missing selected means, no fallback, no kit/output after cancelled or unsupported completion, no4th accepted batch.
